dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, multiple thin horizontal light bands formed by the white distal margins of the greater and median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High visibility with sharp white linear boundaries along the trailing edges of the folded primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Visible boundary defined by the transition from fine speckling on the nape to the coarse scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely repetitive and uniform scalloped plumage across the dorsal plane, consisting of dark centers with broad, bright white margins.
